front.title: CATS C-SMA Nomination Snapshot and C-SMA-to-C-PS Transport Bindings

abstract.t:
This document defines a nomination snapshot published by a CATS Service Metric Agent (C-SMA) to a CATS Path Selector (C-PS). The snapshot carries aggregated service metrics together with a nominated service candidate set.
The document defines the snapshot contract and two proposed transport bindings for the C-SMA-to-C-PS interface: a YANG-modeled snapshot delivered using gNMI for centralized C-PS deployments, and a BGP-LS service-metadata mapping for distributed deployments in which a C-PS is located at an ingress CATS-Forwarder.
The SCI-to-C-SMA interface, individual metric definitions, management models, generic OAM, and the C-SMA's internal aggregation, ranking, and caching methods are outside the scope of this document.
